results.title: Beyond the Trade Deficit: A Roadmap for Managing Europe–China Competition - CIRSD
results.snippet: Europe’s recent policy response has focused heavily on defensive instruments. The Foreign Subsidies Regulation, the Anti-Coercion Instrument, and the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism all aim to address distortions, unfair competition, and strategic vulnerabilities. Europe has also increasingly relied on anti-dumping investigations, investment screening, and sector-specific trade defenses. [...]
